patterns.note: A full-bleed hero section features a fixed background image, over which a dynamic art piece and descriptive text scroll upwards, creating a layered visual experience.
Consistent use of a monospaced font for all navigational elements, section labels, and subheadings, lending a technical, precise, and editorial tone to the site's information architecture.
A high-contrast color scheme pairing a deep charcoal/near-black with an off-white/light beige, punctuated by a vibrant electric blue accent derived from the hero's digital art piece.

A multi-layered parallax scroll effect in the hero, where a fixed background image anchors the scene while the main art piece (a video) and descriptive text scroll upwards over it, revealing the content sections below.

Dual sticky branding elements: the top navigation bar transforms from transparent to solid with a light background on scroll, and a secondary 'ARTXCODE' logo appears and sticks to the bottom-left corner after the hero section is scrolled past.
Content sections are clearly delineated by full-width background color changes (dark hero, light content) and distinct, uppercase monospaced headings, creating a strong visual rhythm.

technique_notes: The hero section employs a fixed background image that remains stationary while a video art piece and descriptive text scroll upwards over it, creating a layered parallax effect. The detected video-hero animation tech suggests this art piece is a dynamic visual element.
The primary navigation bar at the top transitions from a transparent overlay to a sticky element with a solid light background and subtle border as the user scrolls past the hero section.
A secondary brand logo is introduced and becomes sticky in the bottom-left corner of the viewport once the user scrolls beyond the initial hero content, providing persistent branding.

design_tokens.type_scale: A prominent serif hero heading (~2-3x body) is balanced by smaller, uppercase monospaced labels and a readable serif body text.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy in the hero section, transitioning to a balanced and structured grid layout for content sections.

standout: The sophisticated, multi-layered parallax hero featuring a dynamic video art piece, combined with the dual sticky navigation elements (transforming top bar and persistent bottom-left logo), creates a distinctive, gallery-like experience that feels both modern and curated. The consistent use of a monospaced font for all UI elements also sets a unique, technical-editorial tone.
